Haseeb — the opening film

Seven and a half seconds of continuous motion. Business activity moves without stopping; one teal current puts it in order without stopping it; the three statements form into a single block; the HASEEB. wordmark condenses out of that current and travels into the nav. Nothing is switched — one animation-frame loop computes every value on screen from the clock. This is the shipping code: the stylesheet block, the script module and the markup are copied into this file from the site itself. Skip is live from the first frame, and Esc skips too.

The frame is 16:10. The film treats the frame exactly as it treats a browser window, so a narrow window here plays the same lighter field a phone gets — there is no static poster any more. If your system is set to reduced motion, or asks for reduced data, the film does not play at all: that is the shipping behaviour, and the caption says so.
